meta.title: Mistral Electric · Industrial, commercial and institutional electrical work
meta.description: Mistral Electric delivers the electrical work on industrial, commercial and institutional projects across Quebec. An Indigenous-owned company.

hero.title: From plans to
hero.sub: Mistral Electric delivers the electrical work on industrial, commercial and institutional projects across Quebec, for general contractors and through public tenders.

method.label: Method
method.title: Four stages, the same on every project

steps.name: Bid
steps.text: Itemized, with its assumptions and exclusions in writing. Delivered before the closing date.

steps.name: Planning
steps.text: Schedule, crew and procurement settled before mobilization.

steps.name: Execution
steps.text: One dedicated foreman from start to finish. A report every week. Every change order priced before it is carried out.

steps.name: Closeout
steps.text: Test reports, as-built drawings and manuals handed over at acceptance.

ownership.label: Ownership
ownership.title: Indigenous ownership

ownership.note: The documentation required by the Indigenous content clauses in your tenders is available on request.
